subject: Request: Hosted API rate exception for Veridian Labs (multi-region commitment)
messages:
From: Nitin Rao <n.rao@veridian-labs.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Shah <anita.shah@veridian-labs.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and commitment

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Veridian ML team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. Procurement asked me to formalize our ask so we can move this through our internal approval.

High level ask:
- 12 month committed usage for Hosted API across US/EU/APAC (estimated billable tokens ~3B over 12 months)
- We are requesting a 35% unit-rate reduction off list Hosted API pricing for the committed volume (this exceeds your standard >20% threshold)

Rationale:
- We will be migrating two core products onto Redwood’s inference platform, with a predictable ramp to >2x current consumption in Q4
- Multi-region requirement — must be served from US/EU/APAC regions and need consistent per-token economics
- We have an internal approval window: procurement needs pricing and any exec approvals by Sept 20 to include in Q4 budget submission

Attached is our procurement form (Veridian_MAAP_request.pdf) — happy to jump on a call if you need more color.

Thanks,
Nitin Rao
Procurement Manager
Veridian Labs
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Nitin Rao <n.rao@veridian-labs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing ask — multi-region pilot and commitment

Nitin —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timelines. We can support multi-region and the usage profile you described, but 35% is outside of standard pricing authority for Hosted API. I’m escalating to our deal desk and revenue ops for executive authorization.

Prelim numbers (est):
- List unit price: $0.0008 / token (example)
- 35% off => $0.00052 / token
- 3B tokens @ $0.00052 => ~$1.56M committed billable over 12 months

I’ll push this internally and come back with either an approved concession or an alternative structure (tiered ramp + rebate). Attached: deal summary I’ll send to the team.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Veridian MAAP request — exec rate exception needed

Markus / team — forwarding Veridian’s procurement request. TL;DR: 12m multi-region commit ~3B tokens; they want 35% off list (well above our >20% threshold).

Why I think we should consider:
- Strategic: Veridian is a platform integrator with potential referrals for other large customers in manufacturing and life sciences
- Multi-region: they will buy regional capacity (higher ops lock-in) which improves utilization of our APAC footprint
- Volume: ~1.5M/month avg in Q1 ramping to 350M/month by month 6 per their usage profile

Risks: margin compression; sets precedent for >20%. Proposed trade-offs to mitigate:
1) 12 month committed minimum spend of $1.2M (non-refundable credit)
2) Cap concession to 30% instead of 35% as a middle ground
3) Include a 6-month review clause tying to usage and quality metrics

Attachments: deal_summary_veridian.xlsx (contains ARR math, region breakdown, proposed SLA notes).

Can you advise on exec authority to approve up to 30% here or recommend next steps?

Thanks,
—Lauren
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Veridian MAAP request — exec rate exception needed

Lauren — thanks for the summary and the mitigations. A few clarifying Qs before I sign off or escalate to the CEO:
- Is $1.2M the floor (non-refundable) or a committed spend that can be clawed back if they underspend?
- Can we structure the concession as a two-part instrument (one-time onboarding credit + smaller ongoing rate) to protect gross margin?

If finance can present positive NPV under those terms, I’m willing to approve up to 30% concession. 35% feels aggressive without a stronger lock-in (longer term or higher non-refundable).

—Markus Klein
SVP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Veridian MAAP request — exec rate exception needed

Markus / Lauren — I pulled the financials and ran sensitivity on a few structures. Summary:
- Straight 35% off list for the full 12 months leaves gross margin below target (we’d be ~12% gross margin on the committed volume at current cost assumptions).
- Option A (recommended): 30% off list applied as a blended rate if they meet the 3B commit; include a $1.2M non-refundable onboarding credit that counts toward the commit but is paid up front or as a short-term credit schedule. NPV at our cost-of-capital shows positive contribution within 10 months under this structure.
- Option B: 20% ongoing discount + performance rebate (variable up to 15% back) once usage thresholds are met over 9 months — preserves margin early and guarantees upside for customer.

Actionable condition for approval: 1) Veridian signs a 12-month commitment for minimum $1.2M AND 2) We get a DocuSign clause for minimum regional SLA and a 6-month usage review.

I can prepare the financial appendix and update the deal summary for the legal term sheet.

—Mina Haddad
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval: conditional concession granted for Veridian Labs (30%)

Team — after reviewing Mina’s analysis and Lauren’s deal rationale, I am granting executive approval for a one-time concession to support Veridian’s 12-month multi-region commitment with the following conditions:

1) Concession: up to 30% off list Hosted API unit price (applies as blended rate across committed volume) — note this exceeds the standard 20% authority and is an exceptional approval.
2) Commitment: Veridian must sign a 12-month committed usage agreement for minimum $1.2M (the non-refundable onboarding credit counts toward this amount).
3) Payment/credit terms: onboarding credit schedule or prepay to be agreed (finance to draft).
4) Review: 6-month usage and SLA review; if usage materially underperforms, we reserve the right to reconcile with clawback language per the legal term sheet.
5) Legal/Compliance: include standard data residency and audit clauses for cross-region deployment.

Lauren — you have authority to present these terms to the customer and to execute with Legal & Finance assistance. Mina — please produce the financial appendix and the credit schedule. Karthik — coordinate the technical SLA items for APAC routing and capacity reservation notes.

Regards,
Markus Klein
SVP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
